Serie A has always been one of Europe’s most competitive football leagues, with established clubs, talented players and managers who place great importance on tactics.
Inter, Juventus, Milan and Napoli regularly compete for major honours, while other teams are constantly looking for opportunities to challenge them. Transfers, injuries, managerial decisions and individual performances can all influence the league standings.
This level of competition also means that expectations can change throughout a season. The best sports betting odds reflect these developments, taking into account recent results, player availability, squad changes and the strength of upcoming opponents. For this reason, betting on Italian clubs is one of the most common choices among those who frequently engage in sports analysis.
However, few could have predicted how quickly Como would establish themselves among Italy’s leading clubs. After returning to Serie A in 2024, they finished fourth just two seasons later and qualified for the Champions League. Under Cesc Fàbregas, the club has developed an ambitious style of play and recorded remarkable results against established European opponents.
Their progress raises an important question: what has made Como so successful, and do they have what it takes to remain competitive at the highest level?
From Serie D to the Champions League
Como’s transformation becomes even more impressive when considering their recent history. The club competed in Serie D in 2019, following years of financial difficulties and instability.
The arrival of Indonesian investors Robert and Michael Hartono provided the financial support needed to rebuild the organisation. Rather than focusing exclusively on immediate results, the new ownership invested in recruitment, infrastructure, and the club’s long-term development.
Their approach delivered results. Como earned promotion to Serie A for the 2024/25 campaign, ending a 21-year absence from Italy’s highest division.
The team subsequently finished tenth in its first season back before securing fourth place in 2025/26.
What changed behind the scenes?
Several decisions helped improve the conditions for this progress:
- Financial stability: The ownership provided resources for recruitment and improvements across the club.
- Long-term planning: Management focused on building a competitive squad rather than relying entirely on short-term signings.
- Clear football identity: Players were selected to fit a particular tactical approach.
- Coaching continuity: Fàbregas received the support and responsibility needed to develop his ideas.
These foundations have allowed Como to compete against clubs with considerably longer histories at the highest level.
How Cesc Fàbregas Transformed Como’s Playing Style
Fàbregas has been central to Como’s development. The former midfielder brought extensive European experience when he moved into coaching.
His approach places considerable importance on possession, positioning and intelligent movement. Rather than simply keeping the ball, Como try to create situations where players have space to receive passes and advance towards goal.
The team frequently operates in a 4-2-3-1 formation, with two central midfielders providing support during attacks and helping protect the defence.
What makes Como difficult to defend against?
One important feature is their willingness to build attacks from the goalkeeper. Defenders are encouraged to remain composed under pressure, while midfielders provide passing options.
This approach offers several advantages:
- Como can draw opponents forward and create space behind their midfield.
- Attacking players can receive possession in dangerous central areas.
- Full-backs provide width, allowing creative midfielders to move inside.
- Quick passing combinations can create scoring opportunities without relying on long balls.
The approach carries risks, particularly when opponents press aggressively. However, Fàbregas has shown that his players can use this approach effectively against teams with greater European experience.
The Players Behind Como’s Success
Although Fàbregas receives considerable attention, the team’s performances depend on players who understand their responsibilities and complement one another.
Nico Paz and the importance of creativity
Nico Paz has become one of Como’s most influential footballers since joining from Real Madrid in 2024.
The Argentine attacking midfielder combines close control, passing accuracy and an ability to identify space between opposing defenders.
His development has been particularly impressive. After recording six goals and nine assists in his first Serie A campaign, he improved to 12 goals and seven assists in the following season.
Paz contributes more than goals. His ability to act under pressure helps Como maintain control in advanced areas.
Other players making a difference
Several teammates have also played important roles:
- Tasos Douvikas: Provides movement inside the penalty area and has developed into a reliable goalscorer.
- Martin Baturina: Offers technical ability, creativity and additional passing options in attacking positions.
- Máximo Perrone: Helps control possession and connect defensive players with the attack.
- Lucas Da Cunha: Contributes intelligent movement and supports the team’s passing combinations.
- Jacobo Ramón: Brings height, defensive strength and composure when playing out from the back.
Their contributions show Como’s success doesn’t depend on a single individual.
Victories Against Manchester United and Lens Show Como’s Progress
Como’s European performances have provided particularly convincing evidence of their improvement.
Their 4-1 Champions League victory over Manchester United demonstrated how effectively they could compete against a major European club.
An even more extraordinary result followed against Lens, when Como secured a 9-1 away victory.
Why was the Lens result so significant?
The victory equalled the largest winning margin in Champions League history and made Como the first away team to score nine goals in a match in the competition.
Beyond the scoreline, the performance highlighted several important qualities.
Como created opportunities through coordinated passing, exploited defensive weaknesses and maintained their attacking organisation throughout the match.
The involvement of younger players also demonstrated the squad’s growing depth.
Nevertheless, exceptional results should be assessed carefully. Scoring nine goals in one match is highly unusual, and such performances cannot reasonably be expected every week.
The more important measure is whether Como can consistently perform well against strong opposition.
Can Como Maintain Their Success in the Coming Years?
The club has built a promising foundation, but staying among Serie A’s strongest teams presents different challenges than reaching that level.
One major concern is squad depth. Competing in domestic and European competitions increases the demands on players, particularly those regularly involved in high-intensity matches.
Injuries and fatigue can affect performance, making reliable alternatives essential.
Another challenge involves retaining important personnel. Players such as Paz are likely to attract interest from larger European clubs, while Fàbregas’ coaching achievements could generate opportunities elsewhere.
What must Como do to remain competitive?
Three priorities will be particularly important:
- Maintain recruitment standards: New signings must suit the team’s tactical system rather than simply arrive with established reputations.
- Develop new players: Giving emerging talent opportunities can improve squad depth and reduce dependence on expensive transfers.
- Balance ambition with financial planning: Continued investment must be supported by realistic long-term decisions.
Tactical flexibility will also matter. Opponents will increasingly study Como’s methods, making it necessary for Fàbregas to develop alternatives when possession-based attacks become less effective.
Is Como’s Success Sustainable?
Como’s development is not simply the result of significant financial investment, nor is it just another lucky streak of a team that was treated like an underdog by betting sites. Their achievements reflect effective recruitment, coaching consistency, and a clear understanding of how the team should play.
The victories over Manchester United and Lens show their potential, but long-term success will depend on delivering consistent performances over entire seasons.
Maintaining Champions League qualification will be difficult, particularly against established Italian clubs with greater experience and resources.
Even so, Como have already shown that a carefully managed club can improve rapidly without abandoning its footballing principles.
If they retain their key personnel, keep developing young players, and strengthen the squad intelligently, Como could remain among Italy’s leading teams rather than enjoy only a brief period of success.

מועדון הכדורגל קומו רשם את אחת ההתפתחויות המרשימות בכדורגל האירופי, לאחר שחזר לסרייה א ב-2024 וסיים את עונת 2025 ו-2026 במקום הרביעי המוביל לליגת האלופות. הצלחת המועדון מיוחסת ליציבות פיננסית שהעניקו הבעלים האינדונזיים רוברט ומייקל הרטנו, לצד תכנון ארוך טווח וזהות טקטית ברורה.

המאמן ססק פברגאס עיצב סגנון משחק המבוסס על החזקת כדור, מיקום חכם ובניית התקפות מהשוער. שחקנים בולטים כמו ניקו פאס, טאסוס דוביקאס ומקסימו פרונה תרמו משמעותית להצלחת הקבוצה על המגרש. רגע השיא באירופה כלל ניצחון מרשים 4-1 על מנצ'סטר יונייטד ותוצאה היסטורית של 9-1 מול לאנס.
